'''Vec Vennec''' was a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Vec Vennec appears in the [[September]] [[2023]] Game Update 7.3.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Confidence in Power">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20230901-0|text=Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power"}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>

In the Galactic Season 5 "Confidence in Power" missions, if the player is affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Mendi Dian]] will appear rather than Vec Vennec.<ref name="TOR" />
